content.short: Star Atlas is a multi-player space exploration and strategy game built on Solana.
content.description: First released in 2021, Star Atlas is a futuristic space‑themed strategy game built on Solana. Players collect, create, and trade NFTs that represent in‑game items within the Star Atlas universe. Like other Web3 titles, players have control over their virtual environment and can shape the realm by building cities or forming DAOs to govern regions. Players earn ATLAS, the in‑game currency, as rewards.
